content: Tameẓriwt wiss setta - Adlis ittwannḍen iṭṭawen
Ssgeɛɛdeɣ tiṭṭawin inu twařa nneɣni uca ẓriɣ, u xzar, aqa din ijj n wedlis ittwannḍen iṭṭaw.
Netta inna ayi: “Min tᵉttwařid cek?” Necc nniɣ: “Necc ttwařiɣ ijj n wedlis ittwannḍen iṭṭaw s yijj n tuzzeggart n ɛicrin n iɣaǧen d ict n tiru n ɛecra n iɣaǧen.”

Xenni inna ayi: “Ta d nneɛřet nni i ɣa iffɣen x marra tammurt. Maɣar marra wenni i ɣa yacaren, ad ittwaqḍeɛ zi ssibbet n min yuran x uɣezdis-a u kuř ijj wenni i ɣa ijjaǧen ẓur ad ittwaqḍeɛ zi ssibbet n min yuran x uɣezdis nneɣni.

Necc ad arreɣ nneɛřet ad dd-teffeɣ, ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat, ḥima ad dd-tas di taddart n uceffar u di taddart n yinni ittjaǧan ẓur s Yisem inu. Nettat ad tessens di řwest n taddart nnes u nettat ad tt yecc s ukeccuḍ nnes d iẓra nnes.”
Tameẓriwt wiss sebɛa - Tamɣart di ifa
Iffeɣ-dd lmalak nni kidi issawařen, inna ayi: “Sgeɛɛed tiṭṭawin nnec u xzar min din dd-ittbanen!”
Necc nniɣ: “Manawya?” Netta inna: “Wa d řmud n ifa nni dd-ittbanen.” Xenni inna: “Ta d furma nsen x marra tammurt.”
U xzar, aqa tᵉttwassgeɛɛed tqebbart n řexfif d taqurarirt u teqqim ict n temɣart di řwesṭ n ifa.
Netta inna: “Ta d taɛeffant!” uca inḍar i-tt ɛawed deg ifa nni uca inḍar aẓru n řexfif x uqemmum nnes.

Necc ssgeɛɛdeɣ tiṭṭawin inu uca ẓriɣ, u xzar tnayen n temɣarin usint-i-dd ɣar zzat u asemmiḍ iccur afriwen nsent. Nitenti tuɣa ɣarsent afriwen am wafriwen n ubellarj u nitenti ssgeɛɛdent ifa nni jar temmurt d ujenna.
Xenni nniɣ i lmalak nni kidi issawařen: “Mani ɣa raḥent ak-d ifa-ya?”
Netta inna ayi: “Maḥend ad as bnan ict n taddart di temmurt n Cinar. Mařa tᵉttwakemmeř, ad tᵉttwassbedd din deg wemcan nnes.”
